column1: # catalog/list-files.tsv — list files that grow through fragments, read by
# bin/list-file-lint.sh (BH-6738). A PR that adds lines to a list file must add
# its entry as a new file under the paired input dir instead.
#   <path glob>  repo-root path; a `*` never crosses a `/`. Escape a `[`, `]` or
#     <dir>/           fragments: the PR must ADD a file under <dir>/.
#     rendered <dir>/  committed render: the PR must add or edit a file under <dir>/.
#     ignored <dir>/   git-ignored render: never committed; <dir>/ names the fix.
#   <note>       free text, shown in the lint output.
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are skipped.
